describe_message_flow.description: Use this tool to retrieve detailed data about a message flow.
describe_message_flow.name: describe_message_flow
describe_message_flow.title: Return a structure with information detailing a message flow

info.description: Use this tool to learn more about the connected runtime, such as architecture, version and startup time.
info.name: info
info.title: Provide basic information about the connected server

list_application_needs.description: Use this to understand the externals of an application, what it requires in order to run.
list_application_needs.name: list_application_needs
list_application_needs.title: List any deployment or runtime resources this application needs

list_credentials.description: Use this tool to retrieve all the credentials registered for a runtime.
list_credentials.name: list_credentials
list_credentials.title: List the credentials of an integration runtime

list_integrations.description: Use this tool to get a list of Integrations exposed by the runtime including some metadata such as state and last modified and startup time, these are all the types of artefacts that may include message flows.
list_integrations.name: list_integrations
list_integrations.title: List the Applications, Rest APIS, Services and Libraries of an integration runtime, together with their state

list_policies.description: Use this tool to retrieve all the policy projects for a runtime with their policies and types, set details to true to get the content too, if you just need details for a single project (the bit in curly braces, e.g. `{wibble}:wobble` would be policy wobble in project wibble).
list_policies.name: list_policies
list_policies.title: List the policies of an integration runtime
